meaning: A snapshot replacement starts a new lineage.
A continuation cannot cross profile or physical-side scope.
A different traversal implementation is not the same frontier.
Raising a traversal limit and rerunning is not continuation.
Changed authority invalidates the lineage instead of silently drifting.
A delta composes only over the exact parent bytes it names.
Cumulative work must equal parent work plus segment work.
Client-authored or corrupted frontier state fails closed.
